text: player
After a night of reexamining everything, Jane and I seem to be getting nowhere. So, we decide to split up and investigate.
I instinctively jot down the questions that have been plaguing my mind over the past couple of days on a scrap of paper and toss it into the star-shaped glass bottle on my desk.
In the blink of an eye, the bottle is almost half full with the scraps of paper I've been tossing in.
I shake the bottle, and it glimmers under the rays of morning light. I find myself being pulled back into my memories of that distant summer day...
I asked around in the store, and they said this wish bottle works wonders. So I got one for you.
Why the sudden gift?
Because I hope your wishes will always come true.
After A-37 left, I would occasionally throw in small pieces of paper with random thoughts. Unfortunately, the wish bottle never made any of them come true.
I wonder when A-37 will return to One Han City. Actually, the employment contract between us is still active...
Wait!
I send the photo I took to A-37 without expecting much. After all, I haven't heard from A-37 in so long, so I have no idea if he would reply.
Unexpectedly, A-37 replies almost immediately.
(Text Message) This isn't what you should be focused on right now.
(Text Message) If you encounter anyone with that tattoo again, stay away from them.
With a glimmer of hope in my heart, I send a photo of the jade forgery.
(Text Message) It's a long story. I'm now actually a Jyanshi who works as a full-time supervisor and part-time detective...
(Text Message) Can you dig up information on this jade for me?
My phone goes silent for a long while... As disappointment starts to creep into me, finally--Ding!
(Text Message) It sounds like you've signed more employment contracts than I have.
(Text Message) That isn't the point!
A short while later, A-37 sends me a link that leads to a collector's trading website, and I notice the main image for one of the sold items is practically identical to the Heart of Divinity!
I quickly view the transaction's information. It was completed several days ago, and the seller is actually Saturne!
The garden remains the same, and the gentle summer breeze carries along the fragrance of flowers. Saturne slices a piece of lemon tart and hands it to me while I explain everything to him.
Saturne
Who knew that delivery guy would be the one who created the opportunity for our reunion. Haha!
Are you two... close?
Sort of. Haha! We used to be old friends, and now we're allies.
Let's talk about him another time and focus on the jade I sold.
Actually, it wasn't the Heart of Divinity. It's known as Hoarfrost. It's a great piece too, but it's no match for the Heart of Divinity.
However, due to its similarity with the priceless Heart of Divinity, its price was really driven up on the market.
Such a gorgeous piece of jade isn't the best?! Then how dazzling is the real Heart of Divinity?
As I let my imagination run wild, Saturne suddenly whispers rather mysteriously.
Actually, the Heart of Divinity's value isn't solely derived from its quality, its legend is a significant factor as well.
Oh... I've heard about it from Qing Luan. It was inlaid on a royal chalice in Northland and passed down for centuries.
Haha! As far as I know, it goes way beyond that.
According to legend, it is the heart of a god. The Northland Church was built atop the spot it where was found because people believe that it's the closest point to the Heart of God.
However, during a succession ceremony, the new pope was consumed by greed when he held the Heart of Divinity. In a moment of madness, the new pope slaughtered his predecessor and his supporters.
Not long after, the knight commander coveted it as well and killed the new pope for it. The church was in turmoil, and the flames of war blazed...

The common belief is that the red design that resembles blood vessels on the legendary Heart of Divinity was formed naturally, but as far as I know, it was formed with the blood of Northland's people.
Saturne looks down and takes a sip of coffee, seemingly taking a moment of silence to mourn the lives lost in that war.
It's like I listened to a story from that book, Church Miracles.
Saturne makes me some scented tea with a smile, then pushes it toward me and motions me to have a taste.
Indeed, it's recorded in a somewhat similar book that's kept in the possession of the Sage Astra.
Saturne, you seem to know a lot about Northland's church.
Haha! Everyone from Northland has knowledge about the church to some extent.
I even know many tales about the Heart of Divinity, but you're here to locate Hoarfrost's buyer, so I'll get to the point.
Please do tell.
But he was wearing clown makeup, very conspicuous.
Is there anything else you can tell me about him?
Hmm... Before leaving, he asked if I was interested in Bamboo Cloud's roast geese.
Such a weirdo, right?
Clown makeup... I think I know who it is.
Head to Bamboo Cloud and inform Fuuka Minami about this lead.
I leave Saturne's place and take a seat at the café.
I happen to know someone in One Han City who wears clown makeup. I may not know him that well, but it does sound like something he would do...
But how do I find him?
Boom!
AHHH!!!
Ju
Weren't you thinking about me and waiting for me? So, why are you so surprised?
Ju pulls the chair in front of me and takes a seat.
Let me guess... Are you considering the best way to ask me? No need to overthink it--just go ahead and ask... At the very least, I'm happy to help right now.
So, did you really steal the Heart of Divinity?
Is it wrong to add some relaxing comedy to this joyous anniversary celebration?
It wasn't relaxing for me at all!
Hahaha! That's because instead of sitting at the table and play with me, my opponents just want to catch me...
Why did you steal the Heart of Divinity?
Haha! Relax! It was just a joker's joke!
Those two auction house employees were discussing their theft so seriously, and they kept reassuring each other by saying it was all for Northland... Isn't that interesting?
Hahaha! When humans think, even the gods have their minds blown! Boom!! Like a computer system that crashes after hundreds of forms are opened! Hahahahahaha!
I see you're in a really good mood... So, where's the Heart of Divinity?
Ju raises his wrist to check the time, then tips his hat with a smile.
It's almost time. Go take a look at Bamboo Cloud. Oh, Happy Detective Day! Outstanding... Little! DE--TECT--TIVE!
I return to Bamboo Cloud as Ju suggested, and the manager leads me to a private room on the second floor.
Fuuka Minami
Oh, it's you, {var:player_nickname}. You came at just the right time. I heard you were so busy solving the case that you skipped breakfast, and that concerns me.
You're a guest in Bamboo Cloud, so forget about your job as the supervisor for now and enjoy the food!
Fuuka Minami rings the call bell.
Waiter
Welcome to the bamboo forest of deliciousness!
Oh, what a warm welcome...
If our most popular breakfast item is what you seek, then look no further than the Four Heavenly Kings!
I don't think I asked?
Steamed Spare Ribs with Garlic and Black Beans, Braised Tripe, Wonton Noodles with Chicken Feet and Egg Tarts, Shrimp Dumplings and Barbecued Pork with Red Rice Sausages...
Wasn't it supposed to be four...
Everyone knows the Four Heavenly Kings consist of twelve! If they are not to your liking, may I recommend the thirty-six Eight Vajra Kings!
Come on, don't be shy. What would you like to order?
Well... Roast goose?
Fuuka Minami suddenly turns ashen...
That dish is bad luck! Let's skip it for now. I've been thinking about taking it off the menu anyway.
Huh?! Why would you remove your best seller?!
I guess it's time I told you the truth.
While I was eating at Bamboo Cloud a few days ago, I found the real Heart of Divinity inside the belly of my roast goose.
It was then that I realized the Heart of Divinity in the auction house had been switched.

I didn't know who it was, or why that person did it! So, while you were investigating the theft of the fake jade, I used the opportunity to find out who was playing these tricks right under my nose. I hope you'll forgive me for that.
Don't worry, it's our secret. A thousand-year-old treasure that was once inlaid in a royal chalice had been stuffed into a goose's belly. It's absolutely absurd...
Ms. Minami, your roast goose is served.
Huh? I thought we didn't order one?
What? The kitchen said you made an additional order...
Heh! It's happening again. Just put it down.
Fuuka Minami's face visibly darkens. She opens the lid, sighs heavily, and closes it once more.
I curiously take a peek and see a playing card with "I Wish You Happiness" on it. I think I know who's behind this...
But I should keep it to myself!
Fuuka Minami tears the card into bits, takes a few deep breaths, and gives me her folding fan.
Now, it's my turn.
Your detective mission is over. Here's a bonus on top of your regular payment. Please take it.
I leave Saturne's place and arrive at Bamboo Cloud.
While I was eating at Bamboo Cloud a few days ago, I found the real Heart of Divinity inside the belly of my roast goose!
It was then that I realized the Heart of Divinity in the auction house had been switched.

I didn't know who it was, or why that person did it! So, while you were investigating the theft of the fake jade, I used the opportunity to find out who was playing these tricks right under my nose. I hope you'll forgive me for that.
It's happening again. Just put it down.
I curiously take a peek and see a playing card with "I Wish You Happiness" on it.
Clown makeup and playing cards... I think I know who's behind all of this.
Let me check in the kitchen!
Forget it, it's too late. I gave the order to hunt him down right away that day, but we couldn't capture him even after turning Bamboo Cloud upside down.
Fuuka Minami tears the card into bits as she speaks, takes a few deep breaths, and continues.
I'll deal with the rest.
About your compensation for this detective mission...
She snaps her finger and the waiter brings over an exquisite gift box.
I open it carefully, and to my surprise, I find Hoarfrost lying inside!
The are many stories about the Heart of Divinity already, so I'll leave the stories about Hoarfrost in your hands.
But this jade has many stories about it too...
Hmm? Many, you say?
Fuuka Minami fans herself with a smile.
But I think our story... has only just begun!
Who switched the Heart of Divinity for a forgery? Where is the real one? What was that tattoo on Toku? And what did he mean when he said the Heart of Divinity belongs to Northland?
After I contact Saturne, he invites me to meet him at Lotus Gardens.
They say its owner will gain both power and the support of the people, and so it was inlaid into a royal chalice passed down through generations of popes.
The buyer didn't leave his contact details. We just conducted an offline transaction at an agreed location.
Bamboo Cloud
Memento Received - Elegant Folding Fan
Memento Received - White Jade "Hoarfrost"
As the image of A-37 appears in my mind, I finally realize why Toku's tattoo had been so familiar! A-37 had a similar tattoo on his arm! It wasn't a turtle, it was the Genbu!
